name: Pew
author: hundekraft
description: A drawbar organ in a jazz club, played through a rotary speaker. Each encoder is a whole organ control, so every position is a sound an organist would use: blue pulls out the drawbars, green adds the percussion, white adds chorus and then drive, and orange switches the rotary speaker. The screen moves with them: the drawbars slide out, notes fly up when you play, the smoke and the lamp follow white, and the red lines spin round the cabinet with the speaker.
